'''Talaos City''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]].

Talaos City was built somewhere near the landing site of the original colonists, who were [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]], during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] inhabitants made an effort to keep industrial activities separate from the [[City/Legends|city]]. As a result, Talaos City became the center of [[Makeb]]'s banking and technological economy and the heart of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] culture. The most upstanding citizens of Talaos City were typically awarded the [[Talaos City Medallion]].

{{City-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Talaos City appears in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It was introduced in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], a [[2013]] digital expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]].
